- Yahoo BZ=F Nov-3 rows settle 103.60 / 102.74 (contract-roll pair; both legs below the floor). Nov-2 revised 104.77.

## Open signals — interrogation results

Stress-test question: does 76,001 hold? Current answer: **no, intraday** — Nov-4 session low 75,710 (Yahoo) / 75,736 (Binance 24h). Price 76,643 at 12:04 UTC. If today closes sub-76,001, next shelf is 75,000 then 72,000. Falsifier (revised close > 78,900) nowhere near trigger.
2. **SOL_bear_leg (conviction 0.6) — STRENGTHENED.** Nov-2 revised close 91.84 confirmed; Nov-4 in-progress 91.46 with low 90.14 — sitting directly on the 90.0 shelf, last mapped support. A sub-90 close opens air pocket territory; falsifier (> 105.84) far away.
3. **Farside_flows (conviction -0.6) — MAINTAINED, momentum cooling.** Nov-2 FINALIZED at -398.6M — the -1,113.7M preliminary was wrong; cross-vendor check (TFTC November now reads -398.6M, synced) resolves that contradiction in favor of the smaller number. Nov-3: -20.6M. Direction still red, size no longer record-class. ETF cohort cost basis ~81.5k remains overhead.
4. **Macro gates:** Dec-9 FOMC hike pricing ~71% for 25bp (Yahoo/prediction-market, Oct-30) — consistent with ledger 69.8%; the ~80-86% figures are cumulative-basis, not meeting-specific. Midterms held Nov-3: Ballotpedia (Nov-4) shows Republicans holding Senate 53-47; House control not confirmed in sources pulled this cycle — the Sep-30 prediction snapshot in ledger is now stale and should be replaced with certified results. Next gates: Nov-5 BoE + Cook hearing, Nov-6 October jobs.

- Yahoo BTC-USD/SOL-USD Nov-3 daily rows absent again (Nov-4 row present, in-progress) — recurring skip-day pattern; Binance PARTIAL (BTC OK, SOLUSDT 451 geo-block, klines EMPTY_DATA). BTC cross-check possible, SOL single-source today.
